startup.name: Q2Q
startup.one_liner: We help private equity teams find acquisition targets faster
startup.description: An AI native outbound engine for private equity deal sourcing: the buyer gives criteria, and Q2Q finds companies, writes personalized emails for approval and books first calls with business owners. Team of 2 in San Francisco, Winter 2026 batch.

yc_acceptance.basis: The company is already in the batch that starts on the as of date, so this is a note only. A random applicant starts near 1 percent (yc_acceptance.md, 0.6 to 2 percent range). Two founders with a clear customer and a measurable output (booked meetings) fit YC, but the application states no traction and cold email tools were abundant.
yc_acceptance.why_it_fails: YC would most plausibly say no because AI outbound is a crowded category of agency like tools, the buyer pool of PE firms is small, and two founders without a stated PE background must explain why PE firms would trust them with outreach to business owners.

anchors.adjustment_reason: Window of 10.4 months to 2026-11-17 and a round above about $1M. Ever anchor about 0.65, about 60 percent of eventual raisers close in 10 months, and a 2 person team with a niche customer base of PE firms is a small discount, giving 0.32. The odds do not rank Q2Q against others.

bands.rationale: Small post YC round under $3M from angels or a small fund on top of the YC deal. Likely for a 2 person team selling to a narrow buyer list.
Typical institutional seed, near the 2022+ median of 4.1M. Typical seed if revenue from several PE firms shows up.
Upside seed led by a top fund. Needs fast revenue growth from outbound services.
Large seed, only with a landmark traction story or a hot thesis. Unlikely for a niche services heavy outbound product.

ladder.why_it_fails: Seed fails if the product is seen as a managed outbound service with a small buyer pool of PE firms, since investors want a software margin and many firms already use data tools plus agencies. Two founders running outreach for clients is service work. Analogs Verbiflow and Champ in outbound stayed at the YC check, while Thornwick and Capix in PE also show small rounds.

outcomes.why_it_fails: Failure paths include low reply rates, PE firms bringing outreach in house or to agencies, and a small buyer pool. The likely good outcome is a tuck in acquisition by a deal data vendor.

technical_complexity.rationale: Outbound needs company discovery, personalization and email deliverability, all available with current language models and data vendors. The hard part is reply quality and trust, not engineering.

takeover_risk.rationale: Data vendors have the company lists and customers and could add outbound within a year.

brand.name_check: python3 -I scripts/name_features.py --score "Q2Q" --era 2022+ : kind invented_or_proper, 3 characters, 1 syllable
weaknesses: Hard to say and to remember, no meaning for buyers
brand.rationale: Q2Q is a letter and number code with no meaning in deal sourcing, unlike descriptive YC names. It is short but is hard to say aloud on a call, so word of mouth between PE partners may suffer slightly.

narrative.headline: A narrow PE outbound tool with a small buyer pool; a seed above $1M inside 10 months is less likely than the cohort average.
narrative.general_summary: Q2Q is an AI outbound engine that books first calls between private equity buyers and business owners. PE firms are shifting to proprietary sourcing and already pay agencies and data vendors, so there is spend. The company is two people, the buyer pool is small, outbound email is saturated and data vendors can bundle outreach. A seed above $1M within the 10.4 month window is less likely than the B2B cohort average, given the services like economics and small team, and a Series A inside the window is rare. These odds do not rank Q2Q against others. The likely good outcome is steady revenue and a seed around $3M to $6M, or sale to a data vendor.

assumptions: Blind forecast as of 2026-01-05 from the input file and market searches only.
Window is 10.4 months to 2026-11-17; seed means a round above about $1M.
B2B calibration cohorts were used; the 2022 to 2025 cohort is right censored.
